create.name: Shannon Chada
create.bio:
Shannon Chada, whose spirit name Mino Nagamowin Ikwe means Good Singing Woman, is a Reiki teacher, ordained holistic minister and keeper of Native cultural teachings based in the western suburbs of Chicago. A Shawnee descendant raised in the Stockbridge-Munsee Mohican community, she grew up around traditional dance and drum, and her parents' songs and ceremonies still shape her work. She has taught Usui Reiki since around 2000 and also trained in yoga at the Lakulish Institute in Gujarat, later completing Urban Zen integrative training.

Through Full Circle Harmony, the non-profit ministry she founded, she teaches every Reiki level up to master teacher, mentors practitioners, and gives private Reiki, meditation and spiritual guidance sessions, most of them at SoderWorld Wellness Center in Willowbrook, Illinois, or remotely by phone and video. She also leads talking circles, blessings, weddings and celebrations of life with an earth-based approach, and teaches Reiki at two Illinois community colleges. With the Mohican storyteller Shawn Stevens she shares Indigenous music and stories at schools and festivals, and she has presented at Kripalu, including a 2026 online talk on living in balance with the seasons and the four directions.

courses.title: Usui Reiki Training and Certification (Levels I to Master Teacher)
courses.description: Shannon's Reiki classes run from a first-level course on self-practice and the Reiki principles through hands-on practitioner and master levels to a master teacher course on giving attunements. Classes are held around Chicago and Rockford, and private group classes can be arranged for four or more people.

courses.title: Spiritual or Reiki Mentoring Session
courses.description: One-to-one sessions for people wanting support on their spiritual path or with their Reiki practice, held in person at SoderWorld in Willowbrook or by phone. Practitioners can also book mentoring on building a professional practice.

courses.title: Earth-Based Ceremonies: Weddings, Celebrations of Life, Sacred Circles and Blessings
courses.description: As an ordained non-denominational minister, Shannon designs and leads personal ceremonies with an earth-centred approach, from small weddings and life celebrations to blessings for milestones. She also facilitates talking and peacemaking circles in the way she was taught, on a donation basis.
